blocks.explanation:
Yeh ulta sawal hai: permutation ki value di hui hai aur \(n\) maloom karna hai.
Humein whole number \(n\) find karna hai.
Plan: \({}^{n}P_{3}\) ko teen lagataar (consecutive) factors ki shakal mein likhenge, phir 504 ko bhi teen lagataar numbers ke product mein torenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \({}^{n}P_{3} = 504\).
Humein find karna hai: \(n\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{n}P_{3} = n(n-1)(n-2)\) teen lagataar numbers ka product hai jis ka sab se bara number \(n\) hai. Agar 504 ko bhi aise teen numbers mein tor dein to \(n\) saamne aa jayega.

Permutation ko product mein likhein
\[{}^{n}P_{3} = \dfrac{n!}{(n-3)!}\]
\[= n(n-1)(n-2)\]
Kyun: \(n! = n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)!\) likh sakte hain, is liye \((n-3)!\) upar neeche cancel ho jata hai aur sirf teen factors bachte hain.

504 ke factors banayein
\[504 = 8 \times 63 = 8 \times 9 \times 7\]
\[= 9 \times 8 \times 7\]
Kyun: 504 even hai, to 8 se divide karke dekha: \(504 \div 8 = 63\), aur \(63 = 9 \times 7\). Mazay ki baat yeh ke 9, 8, 7 lagataar numbers hain, bilkul wohi jo humein chahiye the.
Dhyan dein: Agar seedha andaza lagana ho to \(\sqrt[3]{504} \approx 8\) ke aas paas ke teen numbers try karein.

Muqabla (compare) karein
\[n(n-1)(n-2) = 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7\]
\[n = 9\]
Kyun: Dono taraf teen lagataar numbers ka product hai, is liye sab se bara number barabar hoga: \(n = 9\). \(n\) barhne se product bhi barhta hai, is liye koi doosra \(n\) yeh value nahi de sakta.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{9}P_{3} = 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 = 504 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n = 9\) rakhne se bilkul di hui value aa gayi.

blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein right side par 15 se neeche ki taraf factors likhe hain.
Humein \(n\) find karna hai.
Plan: bas factors ginne hain, kyunke \({}^{15}P_{n}\) mein theek \(n\) factors hote hain. (Kitab mein 12 aur 11 ke beech dot chhoot gaya hai; neeche note dekhiye.)
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \({}^{15}P_{n} = 15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11\).
Humein find karna hai: \(n\).
Tareeqa: \({}^{15}P_{n}\) ka matlab hai 15 se shuru ho kar neeche ki taraf theek \(n\) factors. Aakhri factor \(15 - n + 1\) hota hai.

\({}^{15}P_{n}\) ko product mein likhein
\[{}^{15}P_{n} = 15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdots (16 - n)\]
Kyun: General formula \({}^{n}P_{r} = n(n-1)\cdots(n-r+1)\) hai. Yahan upar wala number 15 hai aur neeche wala \(n\), to aakhri factor \(15 - n + 1 = 16 - n\) banta hai.

Aakhri factor milayein
\[16 - n = 11\]
\[n = 5\]
Kyun: Di hui product 11 par khatam hoti hai, is liye \(16 - n = 11\). Aasaan tareeqa: factors gin lein, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11, yeh paanch hain, to \(n = 5\).
Dhyan dein: \(n = 11\) likh dena aam ghalti hai; 11 aakhri factor hai, factors ki ginti nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{15}P_{5} = \dfrac{15!}{10!}\]
\[= 15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(15! = 15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10!\), aur \(10!\) cancel ho kar wohi paanch factors bachte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein \({}^{15}P_{n} = 15.14.13.12\ 11\) chhapa hai, yani 12 aur 11 ke beech multiplication ka dot chhoot gaya hai. Sahi yeh hai: \({}^{15}P_{n} = 15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11\), paanch numbers ka product. Isay "12 11" ya "1211" mat parhiye. Jawab \(n = 5\) isi sahi shakal ke liye hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan do permutations ka ratio (nisbat) diya hai.
Humein \(n\) find karna hai.
Plan: ratio ko fraction bana kar dono permutations ko kholenge, common factors cancel karenge, phir aise teen numbers dhoondenge jin ka product 540 ho.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \({}^{n}P_{5} : {}^{n-2}P_{2} = 540 : 1\).
Humein find karna hai: \(n\).
Tareeqa: Ratio \(a : b = 540 : 1\) ka matlab hai \(\frac{a}{b} = 540\). Phir \({}^{n}P_{5}\) (\(n\) se paanch factors) aur \({}^{n-2}P_{2}\) (\(n-2\) se do factors) ko khol kar likhna hai.

Fraction ki shakal dein
\[\dfrac{{}^{n}P_{5}}{{}^{n-2}P_{2}} = 540\]
Kyun: Ratio ko fraction mein badalne se hum algebra aasaani se laga sakte hain; \(a : b = 540 : 1\) se \(a = 540\,b\).

Dono ko kholein
\[{}^{n}P_{5} = n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)(n-4)\]
\[{}^{n-2}P_{2} = (n-2)(n-3)\]
Kyun: \({}^{n}P_{5}\) mein \(n\) se neeche paanch factors. \({}^{n-2}P_{2}\) mein upar wala number \(n - 2\) hai, to us se neeche do factors: \((n-2)\) aur \((n-3)\).
Dhyan dein: \({}^{n-2}P_{2}\) ko \(n(n-1)\) likh dena ghalat hai; shuru \(n - 2\) se hota hai.

Common factors cancel karein
\[\dfrac{n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)(n-4)}{(n-2)(n-3)} = 540\]
\[n(n-1)(n-4) = 540\]
Kyun: \((n-2)(n-3)\) upar bhi hai aur neeche bhi. \(n\) kam az kam 5 hai, is liye yeh zero nahi aur cancel karna jaiz hai.

\(n\) dhoondein
\[540 = 10 \times 54 = 10 \times 9 \times 6\]
\[n(n-1)(n-4) = 10 \cdot 9 \cdot 6\]
\[n = 10\]
Kyun: Humein teen numbers chahiye jo \(n\), \(n - 1\) aur \(n - 4\) ki shakal mein hon. 540 ko 10 se divide kiya to 54 bacha, aur \(54 = 9 \times 6\). Ab 10, 9, 6 bilkul \(n\), \(n-1\), \(n-4\) hain jab \(n = 10\). \(n\) barhne se left side barhta hai, is liye koi aur jawab nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{10}P_{5} = 30240,\quad {}^{8}P_{2} = 56\]
\[\dfrac{30240}{56} = 540 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \({}^{10}P_{5}\) humne Sawal 1(i) mein nikala tha; \({}^{8}P_{2} = 8 \times 7 = 56\). Ratio bilkul \(540 : 1\) aaya.
